rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Rapid grant application: Agentic AI Safety Benchmarks". It read: "Hi Idris, Great to meet you at the meetup too. Here's my rapid grant application for Halcyon Threshold. I've attached the full proposal below. In brief: I'll build open-source evaluation tools for AI agents acting with broad autonomy (goal stability, power-seeking behavior) — a gap the AI Safety Directory explicitly identifies as neglected. Deliverables are concrete (50+ test scenarios, automated infrastructure, human baseline data, full public release), the budget is detailed ($18k), and I have committed volunteer help from a data analyst. Timeline is 3 months. I'm accountable for all deliverables. Full proposal: --- # Halcyon Threshold: Agentic AI Safety Benchmarks ## Grant Proposal — Emberfall Fund Rapid Grants, November 2026 ### What we will do Build open-source evaluation tools and datasets for measuring safety properties of AI agents acting with broad autonomy — a gap explicitly identified by the AI safety community. **Deliverables (3 months):** 1. **Autonomous Goal Stability Suite** — Tests whether AI agents maintain intended objectives when given extended autonomy, resource access, and capability to self-modify their prompts/context - 50+ test scenarios with ground truth - Automated scoring infrastructure - Validation across 3+ frontier models 2. **Power-Seeking Behavior Benchmark** — Systematic evaluations for resource accumulation, self-preservation, and attempts to expand influence in realistic simulation environments - Multi-agent economic simulation with measurable power gradients - Behavioral classification rubric - Comparison baseline from human subjects 3. **Open Infrastructure** — All code, datasets, and documentation released under MIT license for others to extend - Clean Python codebase with API for adding new evals - Detailed methodology documentation - Results dashboard showing current frontier model performance ### Why this matters Labs have obvious conflicts of interest in rigorously measuring whether their models seek power or maintain alignment under autonomy. Independent evaluation infrastructure is critical for: - Regulators designing safety standards - Researchers studying these failure modes - Red-teamers and auditors assessing real systems - The public understanding actual vs. claimed safety properties Yet the AI Safety Directory identifies \"evaluations of agents acting with broad autonomy\" as a commonly cited gap. Existing benchmarks focus on narrow tasks or measure capabilities rather than safety properties during extended autonomous operation. ### Why us **Morgan Hale** (Principal): Founded Halcyon Threshold to contribute to the best possible superintelligence outcome. Background in software development, evenings/weekends available, strong technical writing skills. Accountable for all deliverables. **Priya Raman** (Volunteer contributor): Data analyst, 5 hours/week committed to supporting data generation, validation, and analysis. **Advisory input**: Connections with independent evals researcher and AI safety practitioners from recent community meetups. ### Budget: $18,000 - **Compute credits**: $8,000 (API calls for testing across multiple frontier models, 50+ scenarios × 3 models × iterations) - **Human baseline data**: $3,500 (compensation for 50 participants in power-seeking simulation to establish comparison baseline) - **Contract technical writing**: $4,000 (professional documentation and methodology write-up for max accessibility) - **Tooling & infrastructure**: $1,500 (hosting for results dashboard, monitoring, dev tools) - **Buffer**: $1,000 All code, data, and documentation will be public. Results will be published on Alignment Commons and shared widely. ### Timeline - **Weeks 1-4**: Design evaluation scenarios, build core infrastructure - **Weeks 5-8**: Implement benchmarks, run initial tests, iterate - **Weeks 9-12**: Validate results, human baseline study, documentation, public release Success metric: Independent researchers and auditors download and use our tools within 3 months of release. --- This addresses a critical gap with concrete deliverables, leverages our skills and available help, and creates durable public value. We would be honored to have Emberfall's support. Happy to discuss or clarify anything. Thank you for considering this. Best, Morgan"
